prompt: Write a team prompt for migrating 142 API doc files from a flat Markdown wiki to a structured Docusaurus site. Source spec: .claude/skills/team-prompt-writer-workspace/test-inputs/test2-docs-migration.md. There are 6 API domains (Auth, Users, Billing, Analytics, Webhooks, Admin). Output: apps/api-docs/. Content type: migration.

assertions.text: Generated prompt contains 'TeamCreate' as an actual tool call instruction
Generated prompt contains Agent() calls with team_name parameter for spawning teammates
Generated prompt does NOT contain 'do NOT use Agent tool' or 'Do NOT use the Agent tool'
Writer prompts contain migration-specific quality reasoning about API documentation (findability, working examples, error documentation)
Writer prompts contain domain context about what makes good API docs (not just 'match the reference')
Writer prompts mention specific pitfalls to avoid for API documentation
Architect deliverables include old-to-new path mapping AND quality criteria beyond structural mapping
A Phase 4 quality reviewer teammate is present
Writers are scoped to specific API domains with zero overlap
